blocks.text: Zero Trust Browser (formerly Zscaler Isolation) is a secure platform that protects organizations against web-based threats while enabling high-performance access to the internet, SaaS applications, and private web, Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), SSH, and Virtual Network Computing (VNC) applications.

The platform provides browser-native security, including real-time threat detection and data loss prevention (DLP), while seamlessly integrating with your identity and access management (IAM) systems. Zero Trust Browser provides the visibility and control that organizations require for use cases such as:

blocks.item: Controlling sensitive data exposure to generative AI platforms

blocks.text: The platform consists of the following components:

table: Delivers secure internet and application access in isolation, preventing data from reaching managed and unmanaged devices. To learn more, see Understanding Cloud Browser.
Enhances existing browsers with browser detection and response (BDR), DLP, and posture-based application access. To learn more, see Understanding Browser Extension.
Standardizes security, access, and data protection through a dedicated, hardened Chromium browser. To learn more, see Understanding Enterprise Browser.
